subject: Consolidated workplace sourcing: laptops, shipping partner, telecom cutover & coworking seats
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidated workplace sourcing: initial ask

Hi team,

We need to move forward on three parallel workplace items this quarter and I'd like to consolidate vendor decisions where possible to save overhead and shipping costs:

1) New cohort laptop order (~120 units) for H2 hires (mix of M2 and base Intel).
2) Global shipping partner for staged device drops to ENS and EMEA desks (we want door-to-desk, 48–72h SLA domestically).
3) Coworking seat optimization — NestWork proposal to reduce seats in 4 US markets and migrate flex credits.

Attached are the vendor summaries I gathered in the workspace page (link below). Please review and call out blockers: budget codes, warranty needs, logistics SLAs, and whether telecom circuit cutover (Q3) should be part of the same procurement.

Goal: lock vendors and SOWs by end of week so Procurement can issue PO and Ops can schedule shipping windows for July onboarding.

Action items:
- Dev: confirm preferred laptop SKUs and bundle (warranty + asset tagging).
- Grace: validate budget / cost center and whether we can consolidate telecom billing into the vendor package.
- Stephanie: coordinate with Procurement and legal on SOW redlines.

Thanks — I can host a 30-min sync tomorrow if helpful.

Cheers,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Head of Workplace Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: vendor-summaries-link (Confluence)
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidated workplace sourcing: initial ask

Soojin — thanks. Quick notes:

- Laptops: recommend 80x MacBook Air M2 (16GB/512GB) for eng/ic + 40x Dell Latitude i7 for biz-facing roles. We should ask vendors to include one-year accidental damage + next-business-day replacement as an optional line item.
- Asset tagging + MDM enrollment needs to be included in the SOW (we'll push images + config).
- Telecom: prefer to keep separate unless a vendor can provide a clean handoff with documented circuit cutover windows — we've had messes with bundled cutovers before.

If Procurement can get a bulk discount target of 12–15% off list and free domestic shipping, I'm happy.

I'll be on the sync tomorrow 10:30 if that works.

— Dev
Dev Patel
IT Procurement Manager

From: Shiply Logistics <ops@shiply.co>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Consolidated workplace sourcing: shipping SLA + quote (Shiply)

Hi Soojin / Dev,

Thanks for the opportunity to bid. Per our conversation, attached is a 48–72 hour domestic door-to-desk proposal and a separate EMEA service level with customs brokerage add-on. Highlights:

- Domestic: 48h SLA for major metros, flat fee per device (includes signature and basic setup verification).
- EMEA: 72h SLA target with customs brokerage; variable duty pass-through.
- Returns & RMA handling: inbound reverse logistics with 10 business day processing.
- Insurance: optional declared value cover (recommended for MacBook units).

We can tag and register serials into your asset tracker as part of a standard onboarding package. SLA exceptions for rural addresses are called out in section 3.

Attachments: Shiply_SLA_and_rates_20260612.pdf (pricing, T&Cs)

Available for call next week if you want to walk the SOW.

Best,
Ben Ramos
Account Director — Strategic Accounts
Shiply Logistics
ops@shiply.co | +1 (415) 555-0182
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 13 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidated workplace sourcing: initial ask

All — reviewed Shiply rates. Procurement can cover the estimated shipping line if we consolidate under a single PO, but we need the final total broken down by cost center.

I also approve the warranty add-on for MacBooks up to $120/unit if it reduces replacement time. For telecom, I agree with Dev: keep cutover separate unless the vendor provides a firm SLA and fallback plan.

Please push final quotes by Monday 6/15 so I can sign the internal approval. If Shiply and LogiTech can do a combined onboarding (asset tagging + shipping + warranty enrollment) we get an ops discount; ask them to price that as an explicit line item.

Thanks — Grace
Grace O'Connor
VP Finance Ops
Redwood Inference
From: LogiTech Pro Sales <enterprise@logitechpro.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Megan Harris <megan.harris@vendor-advisors.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: LogiTech enterprise bundle & optional bundling with Shiply

Hi Soojin / Dev — appreciate the conversation last week. Per our proposal (attached):

- 120 units: 80x MacBook Air-compatible peripherals (power + docks) are replaced by the LogiTech 'Pro Kit' bundle for hybrid roles; unit pricing shown in the spreadsheet.
- Warranty: 36-month extended support available as SKU line + enrollment service.
- Bundled offer: partner with Shiply for combined shipping + asset registration — we can work off Shiply's SLA and provide a 6% bundle discount if the onboarding (tagging + MDM enrollment) is done in a single pass.

Attachments: LogiTech_EnterpriseQuote_20260614.xlsx

If acceptable, I'll send a Draft SOW and a DocuSign link for signature. We can also pilot 15 devices in July to validate the end-to-end flow.

Best regards,
Carlos Mendes
Enterprise Sales Manager
LogiTech Pro — Enterprise Solutions
enterprise@logitechpro.com | +1 (888) 555-0199
